description: This PHP source file defines the CalendarEventQueryFactory class, which creates CalendarEventQuery instances configured with date ranges for synchronization windows. It includes validation, date calculations, and object creation tailored for calendar event retrieval within specified past and future days.

classes.name: CalendarEventQueryFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating CalendarEventQuery objects with specified date ranges for calendar synchronization.

methods.name: forSyncWindows
methods.description: Creates and returns a CalendarEventQuery object configured with a date range based on the provided pastDays and futureDays parameters, including optional limit.
